description: React component for Mattermost license and edition management in admin console, including license display, upgrade, removal, and modal interactions.

classes.name: LicenseSettings
classes.description: React component managing license and edition settings in Mattermost admin console.

methods.description: Initial data fetch and setup when component mounts.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate

methods.description: Polls upgrade progress and manages interval timer.
